---
applyTo: "apps/web/**/*.{ts,tsx}"
---

## Frontend instructions
- Use React + TypeScript functional components.
- Keep components small and composable.
- Prefer local state for MVP.
- Use shadcn/ui primitives where helpful.
- Avoid overengineering state management.
- Prefer readable JSX over deeply nested abstractions.
- Keep styling restrained and professional.
- Avoid generic AI-dashboard aesthetics.
